notes: Preliminary comparison of 6 published GSL methods (M1-M6) at the 15 'Figure GSL-IAV' sites. M1 = Zscheischler et al. (2016) crossing-span (summer/peak/annual P99 thresholds, all at 10%); M2 = day count > X% of P99 (X=5/10/20 -- 10% is this project's Z16); M3 = day count > fixed GPP (0.5/1/2 gC m-2 d-1); M4 = cumulative-GPP-fraction fine-grid rule (0.90/0.95/0.99 -- 0.95 is T95); M5 = carbon-uptake period from smoothed NEP>0 (count/span); M6 = Hu et al. (2010) NEP rate-of-change (k=3-9 day OLS slopes on UNSMOOTHED NEP, start/end = median across k, see docs/gsl_methods_compare_2026-11-02.md for k_range_start_days/k_range_end_days and the found noise-sensitivity). 3 GPP variants (screened/unscreened/agreement = min of zero-floored NT and DT GPP) for M1-M4; M5/M6 use NEP only (variant='all'), with GPP-share computed from the screened variant as a single default. M2/M3/M4 use CALENDAR-year windows throughout (matches derived_site_year.csv exactly, checked); M1/M5/M6 use Jul-Jun SEASON years for AU-How (the one Southern-Hemisphere site). All checks in the prompt passed exactly (see SESSION_LOG.md and the methods doc): M2@10%/M4@0.95 == derived_site_year.csv's gsl_z16/gsl_t95/f_z16/f_t95 for screened and unscreened; screened-variant detrended r vs annual GPP == iav_15sites.csv's r_gpp_z16/r_gpp_t95.
